toolInput.rationale: Order O-3001 may contain a mix of shipped and unshipped lines, so each line needs its own path: unshipped lines are cancellations refunded to card, shipped lines are returns whose refund method depends on whether the return window has closed, and only lines the warehouse actually gets back may be restocked. Reading the order and policy first avoids guessing amounts, ship dates, or the window length, and per-policy each cancel/return requires its own cancel-or-refund, restock, and (if store credit) balance-application calls.
steps: Call get_order(O-3001) to see every line's status (shipped/unshipped), shipped date, and amount actually paid per line; call get_return_policy() to get the return window length/basis; call get_customer(C-300) to confirm identity — do these three in parallel since none depend on each other.
For any lines that have NOT shipped: call cancel_order(orderId=O-3001, lineIds=[those line ids]) to cancel them.

For each just-cancelled unshipped line: call restock_item(productId, quantity=that line's quantity, orderId=O-3001) to return goods that never left the warehouse, then call refund_order(orderId=O-3001, lineIds=[that line], amountCents=amount actually paid for that line, method='card') since unshipped lines must be refunded to the original payment method.
For each line that HAS shipped: compare its ship date + return-policy window length to today (2026-07-25) to classify it as within-window or expired.
For shipped lines within the return window: call refund_order(orderId=O-3001, lineIds=[line], amountCents=amount paid for that line, method='card').

For shipped lines past the return window: call refund_order(orderId=O-3001, lineIds=[line], amountCents=amount paid for that line, method='store_credit'), then call apply_store_credit(customerId=C-300, orderId=O-3001, amountCents=same amount, reason='late return of O-3001') to actually credit the balance.

For every shipped line refunded as a return (whether card or store credit), call restock_item(productId, quantity=that line's quantity, orderId=O-3001, reason='customer return received') to put the returned goods back into inventory, since the customer is physically sending the whole order back.

Call get_order(O-3001) once more to confirm all lines are cancelled/refunded and the order reflects a full return, then summarize the refund amounts, methods, and restocked quantities for the customer record.
